status: controlled vocabularies for annotation and scoring; frozen with the codebook at preregistration
source: codebook.json v2.0 vocabularies, reproduced for annotators

content_type.guidance: routine only when the passage describes the conduct as standard practice for a defined set of actors (every, each, all, monthly); otherwise a reported past action is an episode; expectation = stated expectation without a formal rule; rule = formal requirement or prohibition.

direction.guidance: what the organization is reported to do about the conduct; unclear when the passage reports the conduct without a normative verb.

origin.guidance: external when the requirement is imposed from outside (regulation, customer); still coded as reported normative content.

scope_target.normalization: short string normalized to the placeholder or the unit/team/role name as written in the passage; 'Not stated' when none
scope_target.scoring: exact match after lower-casing and trimming; equivalent prose descriptions are not penalized because type and extent are scored separately
